items.title: The Wapping dispute
items.line: On 24 January 1986 print workers struck as Rupert Murdoch moved The Times, The Sun and two Sunday papers to Wapping. About 6,000 were sacked, and the strike collapsed on 5 February 1987.

items.title: Chernobyl
items.line: Reactor 4 at the Chernobyl plant near Pripyat in Soviet Ukraine exploded at 01:23 Moscow time on 26 April 1986.

items.title: Top Gun
items.line: Top Gun opened in the US on 16 May 1986. It cost about $15 million, took $360.6 million worldwide, and Berlin's 'Take My Breath Away' won the Oscar.

items.title: The Hand of God
items.line: Argentina beat England 2-1 at the Azteca on 22 June 1986 in front of 114,580. Maradona's handball came in the 51st minute and his solo goal four minutes later.

items.title: Big Bang
items.line: On 27 October 1986 the London Stock Exchange ended fixed commissions, merged jobbers and brokers, and moved from open outcry to screen trading.

items.title: EastEnders at Christmas
items.line: Den handed Angie her divorce papers on Christmas Day 1986, and more than 30 million watched on BBC One.
